text: Source lives R/: read_streams.R – reader family. read_stream(path) dispatches extension (stripping .gz) read_gpx_stream(), read_tcx_stream(), read_fit_stream(). reads file returns stream tibble (one row per track point) columns drawn timestamp, lat, lng, altitude, heartrate, cadence, temp, dev_dist, velocity_smooth, watts, grade_smooth. drop_empty_cols() removes column entirely NA. derive_columns.R – addcols_* transforms: addcols_time(), addcols_distance() (adds distance, plus dist_diff device distance dev_dist present), addcols_speed() (smoothed), addcols_speed_naive(), addcols_latlng_offset() (coordinates relative first fix, since absolute values dwarf within-activity variation). Pure tibble → tibble; documented one family via @describeIn. Also holds activity_col_order relocate_activity_cols(). strava_repo.R – export import. latest_strava_zip() picks recent archive directory; strava_zip_to_repo() extracts git repository, gzips tracks arrived uncompressed, commits. activities_parquet.R – activity_streams_to_parquet() converts archived activities one Parquet file , rebuilding changed. internal content_check() implements staleness test. dash.R – public dashboard API: dash_render(), dash_view(), dash_update_heatmap(). Every stack keeps prefixed functions internal, resolve static Quarto stack. another stack becomes default, file changes. press.R – press(), one-call maintenance run: import export archive, convert Parquet, render static dashboard, open . Prompts step step’s context, takes every default argument sequence can also run unattended confirm = FALSE. Sits stacks, unprefixed. dashboard_common.R – shared every dashboard stack, belonging none . load_activities_csv() reads export manifest, parquet_stream_stats() reads per-activity statistics Parquet footers, require_pkgs() checks render-time Suggests. Nothing prefixed, nothing may depend particular stack. rmd_dashboard.R – Rmd dashboard. rmd_render_dashboard() renders one flexdashboard page per activity strava_repo/dashboard_rmd/, plus reactable overview table static index. Templates inst/rmd_templates/. quarto_dynamic_dashboard.R – dynamic Quarto dashboard, prototype. qd_render_dashboard() builds strava_repo/dashboard_qd/ templates inst/quarto_dynamic_templates/. Static shells plus data injected classic scripts; see ES modules, fetch . quarto_static_dashboard.R – static Quarto dashboard. qs_render_dashboard() renders one page per activity strava_repo/dashboard_qs/ templates inst/quarto_static_templates/, three overview pages (overview_list.html, overview_table.html, overview_heatmap.html, qmd name) finally index.html, navigation shell. Activity pages nested activities/, template lives matching activities/ subdirectory project Quarto resolves site_libs/ relative . title: Add derived columns to a stream tibble — derive_columns
text: addcols_time(): Add cumulative elapsed time (seconds first point). addcols_distance(): Add cumulative distance (metres) geodesic point--point segments. device-reported dev_dist column present (TCX/FIT), also add dist_diff = dev_dist - distance QA. addcols_speed(): Add smoothed instantaneous speed (m/s), plus speed_kmh pace (min/km). Speed centred moving average point--point diff(distance) / diff(time) window points either side. addcols_speed_naive(): Add naive average speed_ms (m/s) cumulative distance / time, plus speed_kmh pace (min/km). Unsmoothed; running average start, instantaneous rate. addcols_latlng_offset(): Add lat_offset lng_offset (degrees): lat/lng relative first point . Absolute coordinates dwarf within-activity variation, offsets make movement legible eyeballing stream.
